svg.title: Foot: plantar first layer and dorsal inset
svg.desc: Right foot. Left panel: plantar view with the plantar aponeurosis removed, showing abductor hallucis along the medial border, flexor digitorum brevis centrally and abductor digiti minimi along the lateral border (big toe at the viewer's right). Right panel: dorsal view with extensor digitorum brevis on the lateral dorsum (big toe at the viewer's left).
